brief.aim: Y1 (heating load) and Y2 (cooling load) are two continuous measurements recorded together for the same building simulation, so multioutput regression on both is the evident aim; X1-X8 are design inputs with no identifier or target-derived columns.
brief.repeated_subjects: No repeated subject identifier; each row is a distinct simulated building variant defined by the eight X design parameters.
brief.unit: Simulated building (one row per building configuration: glazing area, orientation, height, compactness, etc.)
